title: flightdeck/workspaces-list/v1
description: Each local mxv workspace with its checkouts, ports, routes and units, and how many have a unit running.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

next.description: The next steps, in the order the text prints them. It is absent when there are none.

commands.description: The commands that carry out the step, in order.

call.description: A command line of this tool.

run.description: A command line of another program.

text.description: The sentence or phrase that the text prints for the step.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count the rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

ListSummary.description: What the Workspaces page's header says.

routes.description: Whether the proxy's routes could be read.

running.description: The number of workspaces with at least one unit running.

stopped.description: The number of workspaces that declare units and have none running.

target.description: The target that the workspaces belong to: `local`, this machine.

MxvError.description:
A failure that mxv reported for one query, or flightdeck's words for a
query that printed no failure document.

code.description:
mxv's own code, such as `mxv::workspace::not_found`, or null when
mxv printed no failure document.

RouteLink.description: One route that the proxy serves for a workspace.

route.description: The route's name in the workspace's manifest.

unit.description: The unit that listens on the route's port, or null when none does.

url.description: The URL that serves the route.

Routes.description: Whether the proxy's routes could be read.

oneOf.description: `mxv proxy status` answered, so each workspace's routes are known.
`mxv proxy status` failed, so no workspace shows a route.

reason.description: Why the routes could not be read.

name.description: The unit's name in the manifest.

state.description: The unit's state as `mxv status` reports it, such as `running`.

WorkspaceRow.description: One local workspace, as the Workspaces page draws its card.

branch.description:
The branch that the workspace's checkouts were created on, or null
when mxv cannot read the workspace's record.

checkouts.description: The folder of each checkout, which is its repository's name.

declared.description:
The number of units that the workspace's manifest declares, or null
when `mxv status` failed.

pinned.description:
Whether `mxv reclaim` leaves the workspace running, or null when
`mxv status` failed.

ports.description: The host port that the workspace holds for each named port.

problem.description: Why mxv cannot read the workspace's record, or null when it can.

routes.description: Each route that the proxy serves for the workspace.

running.description:
The number of units that are running, or null when `mxv status`
failed.

status_error.description:
Why `mxv status` failed for this workspace, or null when it
answered.

units.description: Each unit with its state, or null when `mxv status` failed.
